scope: frozen per-fixture dependency-edge inventory (event id -> sorted depends_on set), event endpoints (tick, entity_id, place_id), relation endpoint triples (from, to, type), and full-file content digests for the crossing continuation chain; each pin (payload_schema_version 2) covers all ten declared files — five JSON tables plus README.md, claim-excerpt-map.md, fictional-excerpts.md, inspiration-note.md, and source-excerpt.md — so an edit to any pinned file exits 2 DIGEST-MISMATCH naming that file; no chronology truth, entailment, source, rights, or canon judgment; --freeze is scope-guarded to corpus/fixtures/** and every pin records the fixture's repo-relative path, which verification enforces (SCOPE-REFUSED / PATH-MISMATCH)
precedence: semantic inventory findings decide first (exit 1: REDUCTION-DETECTED, ADDITION-DETECTED, ENDPOINT-CHANGE); a content digest change the semantic inventory does not model exits 2 (DIGEST-MISMATCH) and names each changed pinned file, including the five Markdown files. Exit-2 (could-not-evaluate) checks run in this order and the first failing check decides: UNPINNED-FIXTURE (no pin for the fixture name) or CONTRACT-INVALID (unreadable contract, invalid pin, payload_schema_version other than 2, or a pin that does not digest all ten pinned files), FIXTURE-MISSING (fixture directory absent), PATH-MISMATCH (invoked path differs from the pin's recorded path), FILE-MISSING / MALFORMED-JSON / MALFORMED-MODEL (model build of the JSON tables), DIGEST-MISMATCH (inventory clean, any pinned-file bytes changed or missing), INVALID-ARGUMENTS (CLI usage), SELF-TEST-MISMATCH (--self-test observed outcome differs from the persisted case expectation); --freeze additionally raises SCOPE-REFUSED (target outside corpus/fixtures/**, or a same-named in-scope target that would rewrite an existing pin's recorded path) and FILE-MISSING when a declared pinned file is absent. A path-less legacy pin is migrated in place by --freeze instead of refused. Re-freeze is the payload upgrade path from a schema-1 JSON-only pin to payload_schema_version 2.
